name: jsonldiff
one_liner: Semantic per-path diff between two JSONL streams; line- or key-aligned; NDJSON output for CI.
problem: Every LLM / ML eval pipeline persists per-row results as JSONL and every team hits the same regression-detection wall: plain `diff` is dominated by key-order and whitespace noise, `jq` recipes multiply across teams, and heavy structural-diff libraries drag in a dependency for a one-file job. A tiny, streaming, path-emitting semantic diff is the missing primitive; sits alongside jsonlcheck as the second layer of JSONL hygiene.
